verdict.rationale: Pipedream offers a public, source-available library of pre-built triggers and actions for thousands of apps, and the community can contribute to it via GitHub. That lets ops users assemble workflows from ready-made steps rather than writing all the code. However, these are step-level components, not complete workflow templates, so the evidence only glancingly covers 'start from a template.' Missing for 10: a documented public library of complete workflow templates, a one-click flow to copy or fork a template, and independent or hands-on corroboration of template use.
